description: List identity-verification inquiries (an end-user's KYC verification session). Optionally filter by status, account_id, reference_id, inquiry_template_id, and a created-at date range, and paginate via the JSON:API links.next cursor (page_after) / links.prev (page_before). Returns JSON:API { data:[...], links } — objects contain PII. Persona REST: GET /inquiries.

account_id.description: Filter by the associated account id.

created_at_end.description: Filter: inquiries created at/before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

created_at_start.description: Filter: inquiries created at/after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

inquiry_template_id.description: Filter by the inquiry template id (e.g. itmpl_...).

page_after.description: Pagination cursor: return the page AFTER this record id (follow the links.next cursor).

page_before.description: Pagination cursor: return the page BEFORE this record id (follow the links.prev cursor).

page_size.description: Page size — number of records per page.

reference_id.description: Filter by your own reference-id set on the inquiry.

status.description: Filter by inquiry status (e.g. created, pending, completed, failed, expired, approved, declined).

name: persona_list_inquiries
title: List inquiries
